description: Add or remove a WireGuard peer. Add returns already_exists when the public key and explicitly requested endpoint/allowed addresses match; different settings produce CONFLICT without changing the peer. Omitted settings are left unchanged.

allowedAddress.description: Allowed IP address/CIDR for this peer (e.g. 10.0.0.2/32)

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

endpoint.description: Add only: IPv4:port, hostname:port or [IPv6]:port (port 1–65535); hostname labels may contain underscores. Address-only IPv4/hostname/IPv6 (bare or bracketed) leaves the RouterOS port default unchanged, which may not allow initiation. Ignored for remove; omit for a roaming peer.

publicKey.description: Peer public key in base64 format (44 characters)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_wireguard_peer
title: Manage WireGuard Peer
